Invocation.description: One runtime invocation and its response.

capability_id.description: Capability that was considered, when one matched.

query.description: The intent text the agent supplied.

response.description: The response returned to the agent.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the invocation. Volatile: excluded from the digest.

RuntimeResponse.description: The three — and only three — answers the runtime may give.

oneOf.description: A capability ran and produced a validated result.

output_digest.description: Digest of the canonical result document.

output.description: Canonical result document, as produced by the capability.

oneOf.description: No capability matched the query; the agent should proceed normally.
A capability matched but could not safely run; the agent must use its original path.

detail.description: Human-readable detail for the agent's log.

Digest.description: BLAKE3 digest of a canonical JSON byte string, lowercase hex.

CapabilityOutput.description:
A capability result document.

This is the one place a dynamic JSON value is legitimate: the shape is declared by the
capability's own output contract, which is validated before the value is ever constructed.
It is a schema boundary, not an escape hatch for untyped internals.

FallbackReason.description: Why the runtime refused to execute.

oneOf.description: A precondition of the capability did not hold.
A dependency fingerprint no longer matches what the capability was validated against.
The capability is not in a routable state.
The sandbox was unavailable or failed its integrity check.
Execution produced more output than the cap allows.
The produced output failed its own contract validation.
Execution failed for a reason the runtime does not classify further.

produced_by.description: Name and version of the component that produced the record, e.g. `agent-jit/0.1.0`.

source.description: How the record entered the system.

recorded_at_unix_ms.description: Wall-clock time the record was produced. Volatile: never part of a digest.

parents.description: Digests of the records this one was derived from, in a stable order.

ProvenanceSource.description: How a record entered the system.

oneOf.description: Imported from an exact-shape historical record.
Derived from other records already in the store.
